identity.title: Submillimeter wave spectroscopy of ethyl isocyanide and its searches in Orion

paper_type_evidence.quote: The search for CH 3 CH 2 NC in Sgr B2 (IRAM 30m) and Orion KL (IRAM 30m, ALMA Science Verification) result in a non-detection; upper limits to the column density were derived.

question.value: Can new submillimeter laboratory spectroscopy of ethyl isocyanide give predictions accurate enough to search for CH3CH2NC in Orion KL and Sgr B2?

evidence.quote: The extrapolation of the prediction in the millimeter wave domain is inaccurate and does not permit an unambiguous detection.

method.value: Fit new transitions with previous data using Watson Hamiltonian, A and S reductions

evidence.quote: For the fitting, we employed ASFIT (Kisiel 2001) and predictions were made with SPCAT (Pickett 1991).

validation.value: Compared A reduction with Krüger & Dreizler parameters; rms 30.3 vs 28.7 kHz

evidence.quote: Using S reduction slightly decreases root mean square from 30.3 to 28.7 kHz.

analysis_steps.goal: Search for CH3CH2NC in ALMA SV and IRAM spectra

method.value: Synthetic spectra from MADEX compared to observed spectra at three emission peaks, assuming Gaussian line parameters from CH3CH2CN v20=1 and Trot 200 K

evidence.quote: We used the MADEX code (Cernicharo 2012) to derive the synthetic spectrum of methyl isocyanide according to the CH 3 CH 2 NC spectroscopy reported in this work

key_parameters.value: Trot 200 K; source size 3 arcsec; vLSR and FWHM per Table 5

evidence.quote: we employed ASFIT (Kisiel 2001)
predictions were made with SPCAT (Pickett 1991)

findings_qualitative.value: CH3CH2NC not detected in Orion KL or Sgr B2; CH3NC detected in both; CH2CHNC not detected in ALMA SV

evidence.quote: We did not find ethyl isocyanide above the detection limit of the data.

claims.hypothesis: New spectroscopy allows an accurate prediction up to 1 THz
claims.experiment: Measured 150–990 GHz spectra and fitted with Watson Hamiltonian
claims.result: 2906 new lines, J up to 103, rms 30.3 kHz
claims.finding: Predictions in the ALMA range are accurate

evidence.quote: This permits us to predict accurately in the ALMA range and make its detection possible in the near future.

claims.hypothesis: Ethyl isocyanide is detectable in Orion KL or Sgr B2
claims.experiment: Synthetic spectra compared with ALMA SV and IRAM 30m data
claims.result: No detection; column density upper limits

evidence.quote: result in a non-detection; upper limits to the column density were derived.

why_this_data.value: Public data of two prototypical high-mass star-forming regions rich in ethyl cyanide

evidence.quote: we focused on public data of the two prototypical high-mass star-forming regions, Orion KL and Sgr B2.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: S reduction rejected because it needs 5 additional parameters for a marginal improvement

evidence.quote: The A reduction requires 23 parameters, but 5 additional parameters are required for the S reduction (Table 2).

limitations_admitted.value: Limited ALMA SV frequency band prevents ruling out the tentative CH2CHNC detection

evidence.quote: owing to the limited frequency band of the ALMA SV data, we cannot disclaim the tentative detection of CH 2 CHNC reported by López et al. (2014).
